## Lecture outline (draft)

- **Problem:** The double pendulum, the restricted three-body problem, Kuramoto oscillators. Why an «exact» solution of a chaotic system is impossible and what counts as a result then.
- **Tools:** adaptive Runge–Kutta methods (`solve_ivp`), the Lyapunov exponent, Poincaré sections, the order parameter, trajectory ensembles with Numba.
- **Lead author:** Kirill Bazarov.
